jobs.description:
Job Req ID: 30436

About Supermicro

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

Job Summary

This is a forward-deployed architecture role. You will work with the customer for discovery, workshops, and proofs of concept. You design the AI factory, stand the first system up with the customer’s team, and stay involved through production handoff. You will package the design so Supermicro can repeat and scale it across thousands of customers. You will work with Supermicro sales, factory engineering, and NVIDIA field architects.

Supermicro partners with NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel, and with leading storage and networking companies. Most work on these accounts is NVIDIA-based — HGX, NVL-class systems, and NVIDIA software. AMD, Intel, storage, and networking included when the customer’s standard requires it.

This position is located in San Jose, CA. Exceptional candidates elsewhere in the United States will be considered if candidate can travel extensively for customer deployments.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Forward-deployed customer architecture

Embed with high-profile Life Sciences, Healthcare, or Financial Services accounts for discovery and design. Sit with scientists, risk, infrastructure, and security. Analyze the workload on their data and constraints. Produce the architecture and present it to executives and technical teams. Package departmental GPU and HPC nodes, HGX-class clusters, or rack-scale NVL systems, including networking, power, and liquid cooling.

Workshop, POC, and production handoff Run workshops from workload and data boundary to architecture, TCO, and operating model. Scope and run the proof of concept on Supermicro hardware, bring-up, workload, fail-closed tests. Write the production design Supermicro can build and ship. Bring in AI safety best practices when agents or sensitive data are in scope. Stay involved through first production handoff, then return the repeatable design to scale across similar customers.
Enablement and field leadership Document what worked at the account so the next deal in the vertical does not start from zero. Train sales and field engineers on how these accounts buy and deploy. Represent Supermicro with customers, partners, and at industry events in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or Financial Services.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent. 12+ years as a solution architect, data center architect, or consultant, with production deployments you can point to.
Experience designing hybrid AI or HPC estates: private / on-prem plus public cloud and/or GPU cloud / neocloud. Comfortable working on the customer floor: workshops, lab bring-up, and POC execution, not only remote design reviews.
Experience taking large GPU/HPC systems from first workshop to production, including networking and data center power and cooling. Working knowledge of NVIDIA data center GPU platforms and software. NVIDIA certification is desirable.
Working knowledge of AMD and Intel server platforms and of major storage and networking products. Experience with regulated data, on-premises inference, or scientific computing is strongly preferred. Ability to travel to customer sites for multi-day workshops and POCs.

Salary Range

$210,000 - $255,000

The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.

jobs.description:
Overview

ABOUT THE POSITION

Senior CAD Designer | Virginia Beach

VHB is seeking a talented and experienced Senior CAD Designer to join our growing Geomatics team in Virginia. In this role, you will lead and support the preparation of complex survey and design deliverables, applying advanced CAD expertise to projects that shape communities and improve mobility, sustainability, and quality of life.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative, detail-oriented professional who brings strong technical judgment, a commitment to quality, and a passion for mentoring others. You will work closely with surveyors, engineers, project managers, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver accurate, high-quality drawings and design support throughout the project lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Prepare, maintain, and coordinate complex drawings, exhibits, plats, and models using AutoCAD Civil 3D and other applicable CAD software.
Support Geomatics and Engineering teams with the development of topographic base sheets, ALTA/NSPS Land Title Surveys, subdivision plats, boundary surveys, as-built surveys, easement exhibits, and other survey-related deliverables.
Interpret and evaluate survey data, legal descriptions, deeds, property plats, field notes, and other project documentation to ensure accurate drawing development.
Calculate deed data and assist with the resolution of boundary, title, and survey-related discrepancies.
Develop conceptual and preliminary designs; recommend appropriate design procedures and prepare layouts for surveyors’ and engineers’ review.
Perform advanced Civil 3D design tasks with minimal guidance, including surface development, grading models, feature line and corridor grading, utility layouts, interference checks, and quantity or volume calculations, as applicable.
Prepare detailed drawings and sketches for complex or non-routine assignments requiring sound knowledge of design principles, construction practices, and applicable standards.
Coordinate with internal disciplines, clients, vendors, consultants, and agency stakeholders to support project needs and deliverables.
Review drawings and completed assignments for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and conformance with VHB, client, and industry standards.
Provide technical guidance, quality-control support, and day-to-day mentorship to junior CAD and drafting team members.
Support project teams with related technical tasks, including data analysis, estimating, specifications, procedures, and other project documentation.
Participate in professional development activities and contribute to a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive team environment.
Perform all work in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, as well as VHB policies and procedures.

Skills And Attributes

Advanced proficiency with AutoCAD Civil 3D; familiarity with AutoCAD, MicroStation, and other survey or design software is beneficial.
Strong knowledge of survey drawing preparation, including topographic mapping, boundary and ALTA/NSPS surveys, subdivision plats, and as-built documentation.
Ability to read, understand, and apply legal descriptions, deeds, plats, survey data, and engineering plans.
Sound understanding of geometry, trigonometry, coordinate geometry, and fundamental engineering and construction principles.
Ability to develop complex CAD designs and models with minimal direction in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues and develop practical, accurate solutions.
Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and time-management skills.
Clear verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
A collaborative, team-oriented approach with the ability to work independently and build strong relationships across disciplines.
Demonstrated ability to provide guidance and support to junior staff while contributing positively to team success.

Minimum Qualifications

High school diploma or GED required; Associate degree in CAD, Surveying, Engineering Technology, or a related field preferred.
5+ years of progressive CAD design or survey drafting experience, including advanced experience supporting survey, geomatics, civil engineering, or land development projects.
Demonstrated proficiency using AutoCAD Civil 3D and related CAD/drafting software.
Experience preparing survey and/or civil design deliverables, including plats, base mapping, grading, utilities, and associated construction or survey documentation.
Skills, knowledge, and technical judgment commensurate with a senior-level CAD design role.

The full-time annual base salary range for this position is $75,000 to $98,000 if located in Virginia. The base salary offered will be determined based on job-related factors, including geographic location, internal equity, experience, credentials, skills, education, work schedule, and other factors permitted by law. The posted salary range reflects base pay only. Additional compensation and benefits available to eligible employees are outlined in our Total Rewards Program.

Annual base salary is one component of VHB’s Total Rewards package. In addition to base pay, eligible employees may receive annual incentive compensation bonuses, spot bonuses, and merit-based salary increases, providing opportunities to increase earnings beyond base pay. VHB also offers a differentiating work experience , including a comprehensive benefits package that includes eligibility to participate in the VHB 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, wellness programs, tuition reimbursement, and recognition programs.

Details on VHB’s benefits package can be found here: Benefits Checklist

jobs.description:
About Us

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

Exciting opportunity at MSK: Join our Integrated Genomics Operation
team as a Research Assistant
!

The Integrated Genomics Operation (IGO) enables basic, clinical and translational research projects across the Cancer Center. IGO implements the MSK mission to cure cancer by providing a broad range of genomic services and expertise to our world-class research scientists. We are a high throughput core facility producing >100TB of data per year across >40 applications including “fourth generation” of genomics technologies such as single cell and spatial transcriptomics.

The IGO “Seq Team” provides cutting-edge sequencing chemistries to MSK investigators, from Illumina, Oxford Nanopore and Element Biosciences. We seek an experienced bench scientist who is enthusiastic about mastering a wide range of sequencing applications. The candidate will learn all the nuances of assessing library quality and quantity, learn how to combine different types of samples on to a flowcell and assess sequencing data quality. IGO has a strong team-based culture and as such, the candidate will interface with many other teams within the lab. Prior experience with sequencing is welcome but not required, in-depth training will be provided regardless!

Role Overview

Operate short-read (Illumina, Element) and long-read (Oxford Nanopore) sequencers.
Assist the group leader in planning sequencing runs.
Execute QC and pooling processes for sequencing libraries.
Evaluate QC results and troubleshoot as required.
Manage sequencing reagent inventory in collaboration with lab management.
Maintain documentation in the IGO Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).
Communicate with scientists and vendor technical support and sales representatives.
Collaborate across IGO teams to ensure smooth sample processing and data transfer.
Learn to operate liquid handlers and robotic instrument for high-throughput workflows.

Key Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree with at least 4 years of relevant experience or Master’s degree with 2 years of experience.
Strong foundation in molecular biology.
Genomics experience is a plus.

Core Skills

Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced research environment, managing multiple projects while maintaining precision. Enthusiastic about learning opportunities in the lab.
Critical thinking and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot experimental challenges.
Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to interact across all levels in a confident, concise, professional manner.
Enthusiasm and dedication to MSK's vision, mission, and values.

Location: Schwartz Building, 1250 1st Ave, NYC
Schedule: Monday – Friday 9-5, with the ability to be flexible as needed by the team
Reporting to the Manager, Core Facilities

The Department of Pediatrics employs nearly 1,000 faculty and staff who work alongside employees of Riley Hospital for Children and students of Indiana University (IU) School of Medicine (IUSM) to make Riley Children's Health Indiana's largest and most skilled pediatric system. At IUSM, our mission and core values define who we are, how we act, and what we aspire to accomplish.

The research technician assists the Principal Investigator (PI), within the Wells Center for Pediatric Research and the Ryan White Center for Pediatric Infectious Diseases and Global Health. The Data Lab conducts research on biomarkers and mechanisms underlying brain injury in severe malaria and traumatic brain injury, with laboratory-based research and data analysis conducted at IUSM in Indianapolis. About Innovation GMU:

The Innovation Service Line guides clients throughout the innovation journey as they develop and launch new or improved products and services spanning a range of verticals. This is accomplished using best-in-class services, including idea screening, concept testing, product testing, price and line optimization, package testing and volumetric forecasting. The Global Modeling Unit (GMU) team within the Innovation service line are methodological “experts” that provide a variety of value-added services. In most cases, value-added services are advanced multivariate data analyses such as regression, GLM, discriminant analysis, MDS, clustering algorithms, and proprietary procedures.

What makes this role important at Ipsos?

We are seeking a Market Research Analyst with a strong quantitative background and expertise in statistical modeling and experimental research methods. The Research Analyst, Marketing Science is a resource for internal and external clients in the design and analysis of data based on statistical procedures. As a Research Analyst, you will provide expertise in the appropriate use of value-added analytical models, including approaches proprietary to Ipsos.

What You Can Expect To Be Doing

Clean, structure, code, and summarize survey and secondary data
Use statistical software (SPSS, R, etc.) and business software (Excel) to uncover and evaluate solutions, and assist project staff in running statistical analyses
Apply programming skills (Excel VBA, Python, etc.) to help automate standard statistical procedures and chart creation.
Demonstrate your understanding of multivariate analysis and Ipsos proprietary products, and work with Client Service from understanding business questions to design, analysis, and application
Work from an analytic plan, assemble Excel outputs or PowerPoint decks to provide results and explanations for Client Service
Consistently ensure the timely delivery of error free work

This might be the job for you if you have:

BS or MS in Statistics, Applied Statistics, Biostatistics, Econometrics, Quantitative Psychology, or a closely related quantitative field.
Strong academic foundation in:
Experimental design (DOE)
Hypothesis testing
Regression analysis
Analysis of variance (ANOVA)
Linear and generalized linear models
Sampling methodologies
Multivariate statistical analysis

Experience designing and analyzing market research studies, including surveys, pricing research, concept testing, and customer insights projects.
Ability to design experiments and quasi-experiments to measure causal impact.
Experience applying statistical methods to business decision-making.
Proficiency with statistical software such as R, SAS, Python, SPSS, or Stata.
Experience communicating complex statistical findings to non-technical business stakeholders.

About Us

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. And we are proud of our continuous efforts in making Ipsos the best place to work!

The Innovation Service Line guides clients throughout the innovation journey as they develop and launch new or improved products and services spanning a range of verticals. Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong.

Our success comes from a specific focus in these rapidly evolving diagnostic areas, our commitment to customers, and our dedication to innovation and quality. We’re passionate about providing healthcare professionals the most valuable and complete solutions to improve hospital efficiency and enhance patient care.

Overview

Job Summary

Join Werfen's Autoimmunity business as a Manufacturing Associate I and play a key role in producing diagnostic products that help clinicians around the world detect autoimmune disorders. As a Manufacturing Associate within our ELISA Plates team, you'll operate and maintain specialized manufacturing equipment, support the production of ELISA plates, monitor quality throughout the process, and ensure products are stored and handled according to established procedures. Description

Looking to join a passionate team dedicated to developing and manufacturing life-saving biopharmaceuticals? Avid Bioservices is a leading clinical and commercial biologics CDMO focused on creating innovative solutions to meet the needs of our clients and improve patient outcomes.

Your Role:

The Research Associate, Process Analytics
applies advanced scientific knowledge acquired through a specialized course of study to plan and execute analytical studies supporting cell line development, upstream and downstream process development, formulation development, process characterization, and other non-GMP studies. Working with limited day-to-day supervision, the role selects appropriate analytical approaches, interprets data, investigates atypical results, and recommends scientifically supported next steps. The Research Associate owns assigned analytical studies and serves as a technical resource to development teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Plan and execute routine and non-routine analytical studies supporting cell line development, upstream and downstream process development, formulation development, process characterization, and other non-GMP studies.
Select appropriate analytical methods, experimental conditions, controls, and data-analysis approaches within established program objectives.
Execute and interpret assays such as HPLC or UPLC, icIEF, plate-based assays, residual DNA or qPCR, pH, osmolality, and SDS-PAGE, applying scientific judgment to evaluate results.
Investigate atypical or unexpected results, assess data quality and validity, and recommend scientifically supported next steps.
Troubleshoot routine method and instrument performance issues and determine appropriate technical resolutions within the role’s authority.
Author and revise analytical protocols, methods, technical summaries, and investigation documentation to maintain data integrity and traceability.
Support analytical method development, qualification, and transfer activities in partnership with Analytical Development.
Present analytical conclusions and recommendations to Process Development and cross-functional project teams.
Contribute to continuous improvement of analytical approaches, throughput, data quality, and turnaround time.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in biology, biochemistry, chemistry, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related scientific field, providing the advanced knowledge required to perform the analytical work.
One or more years of relevant hands-on experience in process development, quality control, biologics characterization, or a related analytical laboratory, or equivalent experience gained through advanced scientific coursework or internships.
Demonstrated ability to apply scientific principles to plan analytical work, interpret data, investigate atypical results, and recommend technical next steps.
Hands-on experience with analytical biochemistry, chromatography, electrophoresis, protein characterization, or comparable biologics testing.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Waters chromatography systems and Empower software.
Experience with Maurice, Compass, ELISA, qPCR, or comparable analytical platforms.
Experience with analytical method development, qualification, or transfer.

We offer competitive compensation packages for this role, including a base salary, performance-based bonuses, and comprehensive benefits such as health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off.

You have a "bring it on!" team player approach and an unshakable positive attitude, always ready to tackle anything that comes your way.
Your written and verbal skills are out of this world, and you communicate with clarity and confidence.
You have exceptional multitasking skills and an unparalleled attention to detail that ensure the smooth running of everything.
You are a master at building relationships, capable of establishing connections with anyone, be it team members, clients, vendors, or suppliers.

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Job Description

We are seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher
to develop novel, correlative microanalytical techniques for forensic characterization of nuclear materials, with a focus on developing approaches for nuclear materials characterization across a range of spatial scales. This position leverages LLNL’s state-of-the-art suite of secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS), electron microscopy and other complementary instruments to build upon previous research investigating lateral mixing quantification, age dating, and correlative image fusion methodologies. This position is in the Trace Isotope and Element Signatures group of the Nuclear and Chemical Sciences Division.

This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work.

You will

Use SIMS instruments (e.g., NanoSIMS and Small Geometry SIMS) for high-resolution isotopic imaging.
Use electron microscopy instruments (secondary electron microscopy [SEM], energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy [EDS] and transmission electron microscopy [TEM]) for elemental and morphological characterization.
Employ artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) tools to analyze and interpret microanalytical image datasets.
Apply statistical methods for uncertainty quantification in microanalytical measurements.
Publish research results in high-impact, peer-reviewed scientific or technical journals.
Present findings at external conferences, seminars, and/or technical meetings within the nuclear forensics community.
Collaborate with others in a multidisciplinary team environment to accomplish research goals.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Innovative experimental skills with experience in experimental design, technique development, and execution.
Capability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary research environments.
Proficient written and verbal communication skills for delivering presentations, preparing publications and writing technical reports.

Knowledge of nuclear forensics concepts, material production processes and/or nuclear fuel cycle science.

jobs.title: Post Doctorate Research Associate - Chemical Physics in Experimental X-Ray Scattering
jobs.description:
Overview

At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget.

Our Science & Technology directorates include National Security, Integrated Discovery Sciences, and Energy and Environment. In addition, we have an Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory, a Department of Energy, Office of Science user facility housed on the PNNL campus.

The Integrated Discovery Sciences Directorate (IDSD) leads fundamental research across biology, chemistry, earth and environmental sciences, materials science, advanced computing, artificial intelligence, quantum information science, mathematics, autonomy, and DOE national user facilities. Our vision is to accelerate scientific discovery by observing, understanding, simulating, predicting, and controlling dynamic biotic-abiotic processes and interactions within complex biological, chemical, material, and Earth systems. We intentionally connect disciplines to advance fundamental discovery science, develop transformative scientific capabilities, and address the nation's most important challenges in energy, environmental resilience, biotechnology, advanced manufacturing, health, and national security.

Responsibilities

Contribute to PNNL’s goals as part of the Lab’s Physical Sciences Division (PSD). Through fundamental research supported by DOE Basic Energy Sciences, we seek to understand the fundamental interactions, reactivity, and dynamics of ions in solutions, that are relevant for a multitude of energy and biological processes. The proposed research effort focuses on developing and utilizing advanced X-ray scattering methods, in particular X-ray Photon Correlation Spectroscopy (XPCS), to probe with atomic scale resolution the equilibrium and non-equilibrium atomic structure of complex ionic solutions and solvated molecular complexes. These experiments will be strongly coupled with state-of-the art theoretical efforts for the interpretation and modelling of the data.

As a postdoctoral researcher based in the experimental Physical Chemistry group, you will investigate challenging molecular-scale science questions, including ion-solvent and ion-ion interactions and dynamics, the mechanisms of charge and proton transfer in molecules, and the spontaneous collective fluctuations that drive chemical reactivity in liquids. You will conduct split-pulse XPCS and related experiments using the LCLS X-ray Free Electron laser (XFEL) at the SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory and related XFELs and synchrotron facilities around the world. You will be mentored and collaborate with other senior investigators in a multi-institutional team, including researchers at PNNL, and SLAC. This position is based at SLAC (Menlo Park, CA).

What You Will Do

Propose, lead, and participate in X-ray experiments at large-scale X-ray light source facilities to investigate the structure and dynamics of ionic solutions.
Perform extensive analysis of complex datasets, including learning and developing the computational tools and analysis codes necessary to extract structural and dynamical information from X-ray scattering experiments.
Interpret experimental data through comparison with state-of-the-art theoretical calculations, in close collaboration with members of the theory team.
Work independently, take initiative, and contribute effectively to collaborative, interdisciplinary research projects.
Prepare and publish manuscripts in peer-reviewed scientific journals.
Become an integral member of PNNL and SLAC fundamental chemical physics research teams, taking advantage of world-class expertise and capabilities to advance your research. Interact, communicate, and problem-solve with researchers across the multi-institutional collaboration.
Present research findings at scientific conferences, workshops, and project/program review meetings.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Candidates must have received a PhD within the past five years (60 months) or within the next 8 months from an accredited college or university.

Preferred Qualifications

Ph.D. in Physical Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field.
Experience with XPCS or X-ray scattering methods at synchrotrons or XFELs and/or experience with tabletop ultrafast spectroscopy methods.
Strong ability to analyze complex datasets and develop appropriate models, working closely with theorists; familiarity with coding languages such as Python and/or Julia.
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take initiative, identify new research opportunities, and independently develop solutions to challenging scientific problems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong leadership abilities and the ability to work effectively as part of an interdisciplinary team of scientists across multiple institutions.
Ability to travel from SLAC to PNNL for regular meetings with PNNL researchers, and to synchrotron and XFEL facilities around the world to perform experiments.

Hazardous Working Conditions/Environment

Standard laboratory hazards.

Testing Designated Position

This is not a Testing Designated Position (TDP).

About PNNL

Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is a world-class research institution powered by a highly educated, diverse workforce committed to the values of Integrity, Creativity, Collaboration, Impact, and Courage. Every year, scores of dynamic, driven people come to PNNL to work with renowned researchers on meaningful science, innovations and outcomes for the U.S. Department of Energy and other sponsors; here is your chance to be one of them!

At PNNL, you will find an exciting research environment and excellent benefits including health insurance, and flexible work schedules. PNNL is located in eastern Washington State—the dry side of Washington known for its stellar outdoor recreation and affordable cost of living. The Lab’s campus is only a 45-minute flight (or ~3 hour drive) from Seattle or Portland, and is serviced by the convenient PSC airport, connected to 8 major hubs.

Commitment to Excellence and Equal Employment Opportunity

Our laboratory is committed to fostering a work environment where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect while solving critical challenges in fundamental sciences, national security, and energy resiliency. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. PNNL considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), protected veteran status, and any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local laws.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures and in employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at careers@pnnl.gov.

Drug Free Workplace

PNNL is committed to a drug-free workplace supported by Workplace Substance Abuse Program (WSAP) and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs.

If you are offered employment at PNNL, you must pass a drug test prior to commencing employment. PNNL complies with federal law regarding illegal drug use. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you test positive for any illegal controlled substance, including marijuana, your offer of employment will be withdrawn.

Security, Credentialing, And Eligibility Requirements

As a national laboratory, PNNL is responsible for adhering to the Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which require new employees to obtain and maintain a HSPD-12 Personal Identify Verification (PIV) Credential. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete the applicable tier of federal background investigation post hire and receive a favorable federal adjudication. The tier of federal background investigation will be determined by job duties and national security or public trust responsibilities associated with the job. All tiers of investigation include a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last 1 to 7 years (depending on the applicable tier of investigation). Illegal drug activities include marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

This is a senior full-stack engineering opportunity focused on building AI-enabled platforms with direct, real-world impact in manufacturing environments. You will own features end to end, spanning AWS infrastructure, Python and Java services, agentic LLM workflows, and modern Angular applications. AI coding agents are an important part of the engineering workflow, but strong fundamentals, critical thinking, and rigorous validation remain essential. You’ll work across event-driven architectures, cloud-native services, data pipelines, and retrieval systems. The role offers significant technical ownership within a large-scale, multi-repository engineering environment. You’ll help shape reliable AI capabilities while contributing to systems where correctness, observability, and production resilience matter.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, test, and deploy end-to-end features spanning AWS infrastructure, Python and Java backend services, agentic LLM workflows, and Angular/TypeScript frontends.
Build and evolve AI workflows using Amazon Bedrock, including function and tool calling, RAG, embeddings, prompt design, validation loops, and production fallback strategies.
Develop and maintain Python serverless services using AWS Lambda and Java microservices using Spring Boot or Quarkus, with REST APIs, event-driven integrations, persistence, asynchronous processing, and message-bus connectivity.
Design resilient distributed systems with appropriate idempotency, retry, dead-letter, and failure-handling mechanisms.
Define and maintain infrastructure as code using AWS CDK across multi-stack deployments and cross-stack dependencies.
Design and maintain production API contracts, shared schemas, and interfaces while preserving backward compatibility across services and clients.
Develop retrieval and scoring capabilities using log chunking, embeddings, semantic/vector search, OpenSearch, and relevance-ranking techniques.
Build operational visibility through CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, tracing, structured diagnostic events, and other observability practices.
Own and improve CI/CD workflows using Azure DevOps, including gated, reversible, blue/green, canary, and rollback deployment strategies.
Contribute to shared foundational code while keeping high-impact changes narrowly scoped, well-tested, secure, and maintainable.
Use AI coding agents thoughtfully by defining precise requirements, providing appropriate context, reviewing generated code critically, and validating behavior through testing and observability.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline; a master’s degree is preferred.
10+ years of professional software development experience, ideally working with enterprise server, storage, networking, or similarly complex technology products.
Strong Python development skills, including modern typing, asynchronous programming, data validation frameworks such as Pydantic, structured error handling, and maintainable large-scale code organization.
Deep Java backend expertise with Spring Boot and/or Quarkus, clean architecture, strong use of the type system, and experience with modern concurrency concepts such as Java virtual threads.
Extensive hands-on AWS experience, including Lambda, ECS Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, SQS, OpenSearch, VPC, VPC Endpoints, API Gateway, EventBridge, IAM, CloudWatch, SSM Parameter Store, ECR, and Amazon Bedrock.
Strong persistence and data-engineering knowledge, including JPA/Hibernate, JDBC, transaction management, DynamoDB access patterns, relational database design, query optimization, and analytical data processing.
Proven experience designing and operating microservices and event-driven architectures using technologies such as NATS, Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging platforms.
Practical experience developing LLM-powered applications, including function calling, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, agent workflows, and systematic evaluation of AI-generated outputs.
Experience building modern Angular/TypeScript frontends that consume production APIs.
Familiarity with Docker, Docker Swarm and/or Kubernetes, Git, Azure DevOps pipelines, code review, and multi-repository development environments.
Strong understanding of software testing, including unit testing, integration testing, mocking, and quality practices suitable for production systems.
Experience with secure coding, authentication, structured logging, tracing, metrics, operational analytics, and production observability.
Ability to work effectively with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Kiro, or comparable agentic IDEs/CLIs while independently understanding, reviewing, debugging, and correcting generated code.
Strong specification-driven development skills, with the ability to decompose complex requirements into clear designs, tasks, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
Strong architectural judgment, communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to balance development speed with correctness and production reliability.

Salary: $100,100–$180,200 base pay range, with actual compensation determined by qualifications, experience, location, education, market conditions, and internal equity.

Crypto runs through this company. The team actively trades crypto and prediction markets, and prediction market data sits at the core of its models. Some prediction markets run on crypto rails and settle in stablecoins onchain, while others are regulated fiat exchanges in the US. This role sits across both worlds, so engineers who understand how onchain markets behave and how regulated venues work will feel right at home.
The investors have a long history backing crypto exchanges, DeFi protocols and onchain analytics firms, and experience at a crypto-native startup or crypto trading firm is explicitly valued.

Unlike most crypto startups, there's no token and no "is this a real business" question. It's a venture-backed company running a live fund.

Data pipelines that turn messy, real-world signals (social, prediction market and market data) into research-ready inputs
Trading signals and the research infrastructure behind them
Automated execution systems and tooling that let the team go from idea to live experiment extremely fast
Systems across trading and HFT infrastructure, security and ML, working directly with quant and AI researchers

Python:
data pipelines, signals and research tooling
C++:
low-latency execution and trading infrastructure
AI/ML:
building and deploying the reasoning models behind the prediction engine

1 to 5 years of experience as a software engineer or quant developer
Degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics or physics
Exceptional Python or C++
A track record of building and shipping a project end to end, from idea to production, as the owner
Strong statistical intuition and comfort working with noisy real-world data
Experience with AI-driven development
Deep curiosity about markets and the ability to thrive in ambiguity

Backgrounds that stand out

Engineers at crypto trading firms and market makers, especially on execution, data or infrastructure
MEV searchers and DeFi bot builders with real, measurable results

Onchain data engineers who have also built signals or traded

Exceptional new grads will be considered if they bring real-world exposure such as shipped products, real trading results or serious internships.

A senior or staff position
Frontend, product or business development
Remote or hybrid
Pure ML research. You'll work alongside researchers as the builder.

fully onsite, 5 to 6 days a week. This is an intense, in-person team.

welcome

You will be a key player in architecting our next generation of AI agents and workflows that tackle complex problems, turning ambiguous business needs into concrete technical solutions that redefine what's possible.

This is a hands-on role that requires a strong foundation in ML theory, advanced skills in GenAI application development, and a practical understanding of deploying models to ensure your creations are robust, scalable, and impactful.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and deploy advanced machine learning and GenAI models to solve key business problems.
Architect and develop complex, stateful multi-agent systems and workflows using modern agentic frameworks like LangGraph
Develop and productionize sophisticated AI systems, including fine-tuning open-source LLMs, building advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, experience in advanced prompt engineering development and designing multi-agent systems.
Lead the research, experimentation, and implementation of novel GenAI techniques to solve complex business problems, pushing the boundaries of what is possible.
Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of data science projects, from initial conception and data analysis to model deployment and in-production monitoring.
Apply classical machine learning techniques (e.g., predictive modeling, time-series analysis, classification) to analyze large-scale, complex datasets.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineers, product managers, and domain experts, to deliver integrated AI solutions.
Ensure the operational viability of deployed models by implementing robust monitoring for performance and data drift.
Provide guidance and mentorship to Associate team members.

What You’ll Bring

A PhD Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a relevant field or a master’s degree with 3-5 years of relevant post-collegiate work experience;
Demonstrated experience in designing, building, and deploying Generative AI applications, with hands-on expertise in techniques such as fine-tuning, prompt engineering, Agentic systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and working with vector databases.
Strong proficiency in Python and core data science libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn).
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Prior leadership experience from a relevant position.
Fluency in English.

Additional Skills:

Deep, hands-on experience building multi-agent systems with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or similar Agent Development Kits (ADKs).
Deep experience with GenAI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face ecosystem & familiarity to MCP tools.
Experience with model quantization, inference optimization, and other techniques for the efficient deployment of large models.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and their AI/ML services.
A strong track record of applying data science to solve complex, real-world problems.

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. jobs.title: CAD Administrator
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **About the Role**

As an NX Cad Admin / Triage support at Anduril, you will be instrumental in establishing, maintaining, and optimizing the Siemens NX CAD environment that powers our engineering and manufacturing teams. You will support the organization and its users on the day to day activities by working side-by-side with all of our users to support their needs, ensuring that designers and engineers have reliable, performant, and standardized tools to rapidly innovate. Your expertise will directly contribute to our ability to design, iterate, and deliver cutting-edge defense solutions at speed and scale.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop, implement, monitor, and optimize the Siemens NX CAD environment, including templates, customization files, role-based configurations, and default settings across the organization.
* Provide specialized technical support for CAD software applications used by our design and engineering teams (e.g., [NX, SolidWorks]).
* Manage the incoming IT helpdesk queue [e.g., Jira Service Desk], ensuring tickets are triaged, categorized, and assigned correctly.
* Resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support tickets related to CAD/PLM software issues.
* Meet or exceed established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times.
* Onboard new hires by setting up CAD-capable workstations, user accounts, and software permissions.
* Create, organize, and maintain user-facing self-service documentation and internal IT knowledge base articles.
* Provide technical leadership and structured training to engineering and design teams; mentor less experienced users and serve as the primary point of escalation for NX-related issues.
* Coordinate configuration and improvement projects with engineering, manufacturing, IT, quality, and Siemens/external service providers; act as the technical point of contact for significant CAD/PLM issues.
* Lead or champion reliability, capability, and continuous improvement projects related to the CAD/PLM environment; quantify benefits, document outcomes, and implement sustainable improvements.
* Ensure CAD configuration activities comply with site security, quality, and regulatory standards; assess and mitigate operational and data-security risks related to the engineering toolset.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Associate degree or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Drafting/Design, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an IT helpdesk/technical support role.
* CAD Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of experience supporting or directly using CAD platforms (NX, SolidWorks) in a professional environment.
* Working knowledge interpreting NX Logs/Sys Logs
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with all levels of the organization.
* Problem-Solving: Excellent troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to diagnosing complex software conflicts.
* Communication: Ability to explain complex technical issues to both highly technical engineers and non-technical staff.
* Customer Service: A patient, empathetic, and helpful attitude toward end-users under tight deadlines.
* Organization: Strong multitasking skills to manage a high volume of tickets while prioritizing critical CAD-stoppage issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience administering Teamcenter PLM, including workflow, BOM, and access configuration.
* Multi-skilled experience administering and configuring Siemens NX with advanced troubleshooting capability across CAD, CAM, and CAE environments.
* Experience configuring NX templates, customization files, role-based settings, and standardized environments for multi-user deployments.
* Capable of obtaining U.S. Secret security clearance

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking infor

jobs.title: Dutch Subject Matter Expert – Audio Transcription (AI Training)
jobs.description:
About The Role

What if your deep command of Dutch and your leadership instincts could directly shape how AI learns to understand spoken language? We're looking for a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead our Dutch audio transcription project. You'll oversee a team of language labelers and reviewers, provide linguistic guidance, and help ensure consistent, accurate, and high-quality output across the project.

This is a hands-on leadership role that rewards sound judgment, clear communication, and a sharp ear for language. You'll guide a team through the natural messiness of real-world audio while keeping quality standards high and the team aligned.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: Hours may vary based on project demands, team needs, and project volume

What You'll Do

Lead and support a team of Dutch-specific labelers and reviewers throughout the project
Serve as the primary language and project subject matter expert, providing guidance on transcription, labeling, and language-specific questions
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality standards are maintained across all project work
Monitor team performance and identify recurring quality issues, trends, or areas requiring additional guidance
Conduct regular audits of labeling and reviewing work and provide actionable feedback
Manage project-related communications and questions through Discord
Host Office Hours to answer questions, clarify guidelines, and provide ongoing support to the labeling and reviewing teams
Help identify ambiguities or gaps in project guidelines and escalate issues when necessary
Participate in team meetings, calibration sessions, and project discussions
Support alignment between labelers and reviewers to ensure consistent application of project guidelines
Communicate important project updates, changes, and quality expectations to the assigned language team
Collaborate with Project Operators and Project Managers to address quality, workflow, and performance concerns

Who You Are

Native proficiency in Dutch, with a strong grasp of Dutch regional variation and contemporary spoken usage across the Netherlands
Strong understanding of Dutch grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and natural spoken usage
Experience with audio transcription, data labeling, linguistic annotation, quality assurance, or AI/ML data projects preferred
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify subtle linguistic, transcription, or labeling errors
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch
Experience providing feedback, coaching, or leading teams is preferred
Comfortable working independently and managing multiple project priorities
Familiarity with Discord or similar online collaboration platforms

Nice to Have

Familiarity with Dutch dialectal variation — from Hollands and Brabants to Limburgs
Background in linguistics, education, translation, or communications
Prior experience working with AI training pipelines or annotation platforms

Why Join Us

Lead a team on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible work
Shape how AI understands and processes spoken Dutch for millions of people
Build specialized leadership and quality-assurance skills in AI data pipelines
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

We’re looking for Finance Subject Matter Experts with strong financial market knowledge who also know their way around Python and GitHub to audit, refine, and improve AI-generated financial modeling tasks — making sure they mirror how real analysts actually work.

Company Description
THEOIS is a global organization focused on designing innovative, core-plus intellectual property solutions for individuals, institutions, and governments. The company develops novel ways to understand and respond to trends, complex situations, and broader life experiences. As an incorporated trustee of the scientific aspect of the Council of Nicaea, THEOIS is committed to exploring the next layer of human existence. Its mission emphasizes creating systemized, scalable solutions that meaningfully enhance the human experience and have wide real-world applicability.

Role Description - THEOIS
 is recruiting Computer Vision Trainers to help improve MIA [Merging Intelligence Artificially] , an AI system that catalogues items from screen recordings.

MIA's recognition engine learns from real screen content. Your job is to produce the ground-truth labels that teach it what it is looking at — and correct it when it gets things wrong. This is not survey work and not generic data entry. You will be working directly on the accuracy of a system that ships to real users.

Open to all backgrounds. No degree, no technical experience, no prior training required.

What you'll actually do

Run screen-recording sessions through the PRAIA app as part of your normal daily phone use
Review the items MIA detects and label them correctly — product type, category, visible attributes
Correct misidentifications, missed items, and bounding-box errors flagged by the system
Rate your own confidence so the model learns where it is weak
Maintain consistent daily output

What you're not doing
No surveys. No transcription. No sales, outreach, or customer contact. Your output is a labelled dataset — that is the whole job.

Who can apply
Open to all backgrounds, anywhere
Must own a working smartphone with reliable internet
Must be able to commit 3–4 hours per day, consistently
Comfortable reviewing and correcting visual content at speed

Guaranteed base rate per verified session — paid from your first day, regardless of accuracy score
Monthly quality bonus for trainers who maintain high labelling accuracy and consistent output
Growth path — top performers are invited to become QA reviewers or team leads, with a rate increase

jobs.title: AI & Data Science Engineer II
jobs.description:
Join our **AI & Engineering** team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  
  
**AI & Engineering** leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As an **AI and Data Science Engineer II** on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for driving technology-focused client delivery across complex engagements.  

* Engage with client stakeholders and sponsors, acting as the primary technical point of contact for your workstream
* Deliver components of client engagements spanning solution design, prototyping, testing, and production rollout
* Lead small teams through business requirements gathering, functional design, process mapping, and support-model definition, providing technical direction throughout
* Monitor progress against plan, identify variances, and drive corrective action before issues affect delivery
* Identify risks, assumptions, and constraints early, and implement approved mitigations to protect delivery
* Maintain clear, consistent communication with client stakeholders and internal engagement leadership

  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  
**The team**  
  
Our **AI & Data** practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required:**  

* 2+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or Generative AI, including developing or prototyping LLM applications using LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, or vector retrieval
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Python and SQL across enterprise data, analytics, and machine learning platforms
* 1+ year of experience developing enterprise data products, data models, automated analytics pipelines, and decision-support solutions for reporting, trend analysis, traceability, or root-cause analysis
* 1+ year experience leading workstreams or small delivery teams within technology engagements
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

  
**Preferred:**  

* Experience in consulting or other client-facing delivery roles
* Experience using Claude through one or more of the following: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or the native Anthropic API
* Experience designing or implementing production agentic workflows involving capabilities such as orchestration, tool integration, state management, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls
* Professional certification(s) in Generative AI, machine learning, or cloud AI technologies, such as Anthropic Claude, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Google Cloud Generative AI Leader, Microsoft Azure AI, or CompTIA AI+.
* Experience developing client-facing materials for workshops and interactive sessions
* Experience presenting technical content to technical and nontechnical audiences in both small- and large- group settings

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $179,500.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description:
**About Aura Diagnostics**

Aura Diagnostics is a veterinary technology startup developing a cancer screening test for dogs. Veterinary clinics mail us nail clippings from their patients, and we analyze them in our Petaluma lab. Our first validation study was published in a peer-reviewed journal, and we're now preparing for commercial launch.

**About the role**

We're hiring one or two part-time technicians to prepare and scan the nail samples that arrive at our lab. You'll work independently and set your own schedule within lab hours. The work is repetitive and exacting: each sample has to be handled the same way every time and recorded correctly, because a veterinarian will rely on the result. If you like quiet, focused, hands-on work and take pride in getting details right, this job will suit you.

Students are welcome to apply. We'll work around your school schedule.

**What you'll do**

* Prepare nail samples for scanning using a scalpel blade and tweezers
* Load samples into the instrument and run scans
* Enter sample and patient information into our computer system exactly as provided
* Check each sample's label against its record before and after scanning
* Keep your workstation, tools and sample storage clean and organized
* Report any damaged, mislabeled or unusual samples

**What we're looking for**

Required:

* Steady hands and comfort doing fine work with small tools
* Attention to detail
* Accurate data entry and basic computer skills
* Ability to do repetitive tasks carefully for several hours at a time
* Ability to work independently and follow written procedures
* Availability for 15–20 hours per week

No previous lab experience is required. We'll train you on our instruments and procedures.

**Schedule and pay**

* 15–20 hours per week with flexible hours, including around class schedules
* $22 per hour
* This is a part-time hourly position. It does not include health insurance.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a sentence or two about any experience you have with detailed-oriented work.

Pay: $22.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior R&D Technician, Space PV Prototyping
jobs.description:
At Tandem PV, we are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by bringing cost effective solar panels onto the market. We’re scaling metal-halide perovskite solar technology to make best-in-class mechanically stacked tandem modules. We have built efficient, durable cells, monolithic multi-cell submodules, and packaged modules with our scalable, low-cost process. Our next focus is expanding our team to work in our new pilot manufacturing facility.

**Job Summary:**

As a Senior R&D Technician, Space PV Prototyping, you will work with our engineers and technicians to build prototype solar devices for spacecraft on ultrathin and flexible substrates: preparing substrates, running deposition, coating and patterning tools, laminating covers, and measuring results. Much of what you handle is a fraction of a millimeter thick and hard to replace, so careful execution, exact adherence to written procedures and meticulous records are central to the role. Your work produces the consistent, well-documented sample sets that our development and test campaigns depend on.

**To be great at this role, you will have:**

* Clean, inspect, photograph and log substrates, and keep accurate inventory of limited, high-value materials.
* Load and run sputter and evaporation processes, including bake-outs and controlled pump-down and vent sequences.
* Coat and thermally process device layers to fixed recipes, and flag anything that looks different from previous runs.
* Set up and run laser patterning steps, then inspect the result under a microscope and measure electrical isolation.
* Laminate cover materials, including very thin ones, and inspect for voids and edge-seal quality; handle ultrathin substrates and release them from carriers once formally qualified.
* Perform routine metrology: sheet-resistance mapping, transmittance, profilometry, optical microscopy, luminescence imaging and current-voltage measurement.
* Keep run logs and per-part travelers (tools, recipes, temperatures, vacuum cycles, operator, timestamps), and prepare and ship sample batches to external test partners.
* Build, label, mount and wire coupon sets for test campaigns and exposure chambers, and perform routine tool care, including early warning when a tool starts to drift.

**Qualifications:**

* Steady hands and patience for delicate manual work; this is the single most important qualification for the role.
* Meticulous documentation habits: detailed, legible and consistent notes of processing conditions.
* Follows written procedures exactly, and speaks up when a procedure does not match what is actually in front of you.
* Problem-solving orientation and the ability to work autonomously once trained, as part of a team in a scientific or technical environment.
* Adaptability across a wide range of laboratory tasks and willingness to learn new concepts, tools and measurements.
* Comfortable with basic laboratory arithmetic, unit conversion, and reading a specification or drawing.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, including working in a cleanroom environment while wearing required PPE and gowning; working on your feet for extended periods as required by laboratory activities; occasionally lifting, carrying, or moving materials weighing up to approximately 25 pounds; and safely working in laboratory and manufacturing environments where solvents, chemicals, and Class 4 laser systems may be present. Employees will be required to follow applicable safety procedures and complete required safety training.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Laboratory, cleanroom, semiconductor, display or precision manufacturing background, including handling thin glass, silicon wafers or display panels.
* Operation of vacuum systems, thermal evaporation or sputter deposition, solution coating (blade or slot-die), or laser tools.
* Experience in an ISO 9001, AS9100 or similarly controlled environment, or with fine assembly, soldering, precision dispensing or hermetic sealing.

This position may require access to technology and/or technical data subject to U.S. export-control laws. Any eligibility or access requirements will be applied in accordance with applicable U.S. export-control laws, regulations, licenses or authorizations, government-contract requirements, and applicable anti-discrimination laws.

Tandem PV uses perovskite & silicon mechanically-stacked tandems to upgrade silicon solar panels, sharply decreasing installed systems costs, significantly increasing module manufacturing profit margins, and opening up vast new solar markets in the US and worldwide. TPV was co-founded by Stanford PhDs Colin Bailie and Chris Eberspacher; is advised by industry experts from Corning, First Solar, Vivint Solar, and Kateeva; has raised more than $50M in Series A funding. We were recently recognized as the Best Pre-Commercial Venture of 2025 by the Industry Growth Forum (IGF)

We are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by delivering a new generation of solar panels to the market. We are constantly growing and are always looking for dedicated, hardworking, and empathetic teammates.

Tandem PV is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
**Laboratory Technician**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Fulltime Regular  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
A Caltech Lab is seeking a Laboratory Technician to support the day-to-day technical operations of its cleanroom facilities on the Caltech campus.  
  
The Technician will help maintain and organize the cleanroom labs - wet/dry labs, mechanical equipment rooms, and supply and chemical storage areas - keeping supplies well stocked and daily operations running smoothly for the lab's research team, while working closely with senior technicians and equipment engineers.  
  
The Technician will assist with routine, hands-on tasks and gradually take on greater responsibility - including nanofabrication equipment maintenance and facilities coordination - as they build experience. Overall, the Technician is expected to contribute to the lab's culture and capabilities and grow into a more developed technician role over time.  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  
**Facilities monitoring and coordination:**  

* Monitor lab facility systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, compressed gas, and DI water lines) for signs of malfunction - unusual noise, temperature drift, leaks, alarms - and report issues promptly to the Lab Manager and/or Caltech Facilities.
* Track critical environmental parameters (temperature, humidity, particle counts, gas levels) that affect equipment performance and researcher safety, and escalate deviations quickly.

**Inventory and procurement:**  

* Organize and perform inventory counts of stockroom supplies, including equipment, maintenance spares, consumables, PPE, chemicals, gas cylinders, and other hazardous and nonhazardous materials.
* Place orders for consumables and coordinate delivery with vendors. Flag vendor issues (communication, quality, lead time) to the lab supervisor and help resolve them.

**Lab standards and documentation:**  

* Maintain the cleanroom's hygiene standards, keeping workspaces organized and clean. Coordinate routine cleaning with vendors.
* Keep organized data records, troubleshooting documentation, and standard operating procedures to track equipment performance and guide future maintenance.
* Support broader lab safety practices alongside the Lab Safety Officer.
* Help identify and implement process improvements across equipment maintenance and lab operations.

**Communication and lab culture:**  

* Communicate progress and problems to the supervisor via email/phone, in meetings, and in reports, matching the format to the urgency and scope.
* Raise difficult or uncomfortable issues (e.g., equipment damage, missed protocols, delays) as soon as they're identified - early transparency protects the lab and its researchers more than a delayed or filtered report.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  
**Experience and technical skill:**  

* Willingness to learn equipment operation, basic maintenance, and lab procedures in a cleanroom environment; prior hands-on experience (school, hobby, work, or military) is a plus but not required.
* Basic mechanical aptitude and comfort using hand tools and basic measurement instruments.
* Proficiency with Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

**Work style and collaboration:**  

* Attention to detail and a willingness to learn problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Willingness to maintain highly organized data records.
* Ability to learn quickly and take direction from senior technicians and the lab supervisor.
* A desire to meet high standards and grow into greater responsibility over time.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks, with increasing responsibility.
* Strong communication skills with the supervisor, vendors, and lab users.
* Teamwork skills and an ability to collaborate with coworkers having diverse skills and backgrounds.

**Schedule and physical requirements:**  

* On-site during peak hours (8am-5pm, Monday through Friday), with the ability to work early mornings, evenings, and weekends when necessary.
* Able to work in a cleanroom setting, following all established protocols for gowning, PPE, and safety.
* Able to lift up to 20 lbs.

  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume
